pageTitle: Holm Open Translate — JSON translation workspace
headline: Remove language barriers in your application.
intro: Select your JSON files, specify the target languages, and download your translation archive when it's ready.
startHint: Select your files and languages to get started.
fileHint: You can select one or more .json files.
submit: Start the translation and download the archive
emptyHistory:
There is no archive for this session yet.
It will appear here when your first translation is complete.
progressDone: The translation process was successfully completed
sourceHint: Select the actual language of the file. All listed language pairs are supported. Pairs other than English are translated in two steps through English; this may increase the time and API usage.
progressWaiting: Translation is in progress. It may take a few minutes depending on the file size; please keep this page open.
progressError: The translation could not be completed. Please check your connection and try again.
fileLimitHint: A maximum of 10 JSON files can be selected.
languageLimitHint: A maximum of 8 target languages can be selected.
